note: P4322 (Pro 28:12) — when the righteous triumph, great glory; when the wicked rise, people hide.

dims.v: public good — the glory when the righteous prevail
the righteous whose triumph brings great glory — the public flourishing and joy of a society when good men hold sway, the opposite of the fear the wicked's rise brings
the wicked's rise it is set against (266547)
set against the wicked whose ascendancy makes people hide

tsaddiq — 'when the RIGHTEOUS triumph, there is great glory'; the ascendancy of the good is a public blessing, a time of glory and confidence (cf 28:28; 29:2). Who holds power shapes a whole people's life.
public fear — people hiding when the wicked come to power
the wicked whose rise to power makes people hide themselves — tyranny driving the populace into concealment, the dark opposite of the glory the righteous bring
the righteous triumph it is set against (266543)
set against the righteous whose triumph brings glory
rasha — 'but when the WICKED rise, people hide themselves'; the ascendancy of the wicked spreads fear, driving good people into hiding. Bad rulers make a whole society cower (cf 28:28; 29:16).
